description: Read one version in full: image, resources, ports, max_duration, whether image caching (force_cache) and verify_image are on, restart policy, and the names of its env vars (values are never shown). Use it before edgegap_update_app_version or edgegap_deploy to check what a version will do.

version.description: Version name, as listed by edgegap_list_app_versions.

name: edgegap_get_app_version
title: Get one application version
